name: Outlier Desk Admin · AI Pitch Spot-Check

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: All settings in one place: your live site URL and the email that receives admin mail.

parameters.query:
select p.id, p.platform, p.format_label, p.hook_category, p.teaser, p.source_views, p.channel_median_views,
       p.multiplier::float as multiplier, p.source_posted_on::text as source_posted_on, p.duration_seconds,
       s.source_url, s.hook_text, s.why_it_worked, s.instructions, s.adaptation_notes,
       pr.id as cre_id, pr.display_name as cre_name, b.title as brief_title, b.platform as brief_platform,
       (select count(*) from pitches x where x.cre_id = p.cre_id)::int as cre_total_pitches
  from pitches p
  join pitch_secrets s on s.pitch_id = p.id
  join profiles pr on pr.id = p.cre_id
  join briefs b on b.id = p.brief_id
 where p.submitted_at > now() - interval '7 days'
   and (select count(*) from pitches x where x.cre_id = p.cre_id and x.submitted_at <= p.submitted_at) <= 20
   and not exists (select 1 from admin_alert_log l where l.kind = 'pitch_check' and l.entity_id = p.id::text)
 order by p.submitted_at
 limit 10

nodes.name: New Researchers' Pitches
nodes.notes: The first 20 pitches of every researcher, not yet checked, 10 per run.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: `You are the trust & safety reviewer for Outlier Desk, a marketplace where researchers sell proven short-form video ideas. Review this pitch from a NEW researcher for signs of fake or low-quality work.

Pitch (JSON):
${JSON.stringify({ platform: $json.platform, brief_platform: $json.brief_platform, format: $json.format_label, hook_type: $json.hook_category,
  teaser: $json.teaser, views: $json.source_views, channel_median: $json.channel_median_views, score: $json.multiplier,
  posted: $json.source_posted_on, length_s: $json.duration_seconds, source_url: $json.source_url, hook: $json.hook_text,
  why_it_worked: $json.why_it_worked, instructions: $json.instructions, adaptation_notes: $json.adaptation_notes })}

Check:
1. Numbers: implausible views vs channel median (e.g. median above views, score over 200x, round made-up numbers).
2. Source: does the URL's site match the stated platform (tiktok.com, instagram.com/reel, youtube.com/shorts, facebook.com)?
3. Hook leak: does the teaser give away the hook?
4. Effort: generic, copy-paste or nonsensical "why it worked" / instructions.
5. Contact details or attempts to move off-platform anywhere.

Return JSON only: {"risk": "low" | "medium" | "high", "kind": "fake_proof" | "other", "reasons": ["short, specific reasons"]}
Use "fake_proof" when the numbers or source look made up. Be fair: most pitches from honest new researchers are "low".` }] }], generationConfig: { responseMimeType: 'application/json', temperature: 0.2 } }) }}

nodes.name: Gemini: Review Pitch
nodes.notes: Why HTTP: Gemini JSON mode. Credential = Header Auth, name x-goog-api-key (keeps the key out of URLs and logs). Runs once per pitch. On failure the pitch is left unchecked and retried next run.

assignments.name: verdict
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { try { const v = JSON.parse($json.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text); return { risk: ['low','medium','high'].includes(v.risk) ? v.risk : 'unknown', kind: v.kind === 'fake_proof' ? 'fake_proof' : 'other', reasons: Array.isArray(v.reasons) ? v.reasons.slice(0, 5).map(String) : [] }; } catch (e) { return { risk: 'unknown', kind: 'other', reasons: [] }; } })() }}

nodes.name: Read Verdict
nodes.notes: Bad or missing AI output becomes risk 'unknown' and is retried next run, never silently passed.

parameters.query: insert into admin_alert_log(kind, entity_id) values ('pitch_check', $1) on conflict do nothing

insert into flags(kind, subject_user, entity_type, entity_id, excerpt)
values ($1::flag_kind, $2::uuid, 'pitch', $3, $4)

nodes.name: File Flag
nodes.notes: Shows up in Admin → Flags with the AI's reasons. alwaysOutputData: an INSERT returns no rows, and the email after it must still run.

parameters.subject: ={{ 'Outlier Desk: AI flagged ' + $json.findings.length + ' pitch(es) to review' }}
parameters.message:
={{ (() => { const esc = (s) => String(s ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&').replace(//g, '>'); const a = $('Config').first().json.app_url; const f = $('Suspicious?').all().map(i => i.json); const items = f.map(x => `
  • ${esc(x.cre_name)} on “${esc(x.brief_title)}” · risk ${x.verdict.risk}
    ${x.verdict.reasons.map(esc).join('
    ')}
    • `).join(''); return `

    AI spot-check: ${f.length} pitch(es) to look at

      ${items}

    Open flags

    `; })() }}

parameters.content:
## AI pitch spot-check · every 15 minutes
Checks the **first 20 pitches of every new researcher** (numbers, source link vs platform, hook leaks, low-effort copy, contact details). Medium/high risk → a flag in **Admin → Flags** + an email. Each pitch is checked once.

**Setup:** Gemini credential (Header Auth `x-goog-api-key`).
